notes.subject: תאמינו
notes.rationale: Aẓar aman = 'ad d-yedu ɣer yidistir-aɣella'; tisuqil timeqranin qqurent-tent d 'tanemmirt/tamanit' (ḥighest faith), maca deg tseddart-agi d asnubget n wemdan i d-yesbeggnen.

notes.subject: תאמינו / תשמאילו
notes.rationale: Sin n yiwudam n yidistiren: aɣella d aẓelmaḍ — taɛbranit tettak-d tamawt s yisekkilen, taqbaylit yessefk ad tn-id-tesbeggnen s wawalen-nnsen.

notes.subject: ימין/שמאל
notes.rationale: Amperid ger idistiren: d allal n tnefsirt i d-iteddun deg tmeẓẓuɣin-ik, ma yella tuzeddiḍ deg yiwen seg sin.

translation: D yimeẓẓuɣen-ik ad tslewḍeḍ awal seg deffir-ik, ad yini: Wagi d abrid, ttekkti-t deg-s; mi ara t-refḍeḍ s yidistir-aɣella, neɣ mi ara t-refḍeḍ s yidistir-aẓelmaḍ.
